steps.label: Backup Verification
steps.sub: real point-in-time restore to a throwaway DB, monthly

caption: Managed identity auth -- no stored SQL password inside the runbook.

eyebrow: A backup nobody has restored is just a hope
code:
Restore-AzSqlDatabase -FromPointInTimeBackup `
  -PointInTime (Get-Date).AddMinutes(-15) `
  -TargetDatabaseName $testDb ...

if ($check.cnt -le 0) {
  throw "Restore test produced zero rows -- PITR cannot be trusted."
}
Remove-AzSqlDatabase ... -DatabaseName $testDb -Force
caption: Restores to a throwaway database, checks it for real rows, then tears it down.
